research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: The Flex Co. is researching period care devices and garments. Applicator for a menstrual disc describes an insertion tool that holds and rotates a disc into the vaginal fornix for proper placement. Menstrual disc with release mechanism focuses on a disc with a foldable rim and integrated removal feature that avoids disrupting anatomical fit. Tunable absorbent undergarment covers adjustable absorbent zones for fluids and semi solids. Together, these areas are menstrual discs, applicators, and absorbent undergarments.

overview_description.description:
The Flex Co. is the top-selling sustainable period care brand known for creating a more comfortable period for everyone. 

Our patented product portfolio, including Flex Disc™, Flex Cup™, Flex Reusable Disc™, Softdisc®, and Softcup®, is sold in over 25,000 retailers in the United States. Based in Venice, California, The Flex Co. is FDA-registered and is the sole designer of its products which are manufactured in the United States and Canada. 

Led by founder & CEO Lauren Schulte Wang, our team is working to create life-changing experiences through the products we make and conversations we spark. Learn more at flexfits.com.

about_short_description.short_description: The Flex Co. is the top-selling sustainable period care brand known for creating a more comfortable period for everyone.

product.name: Flex Disc
product.description: A disposable menstrual disc designed as an alternative to tampons, collecting menstrual fluid for up to 12 hours across light to heavy flow and overnight use.

product.name: Flex Reusable Disc
product.description: A reusable menstrual disc made from medical-grade silicone that provides up to 12 hours of menstrual protection and can be cleaned and reused for years.

product.name: Flex Cup
product.description: A reusable menstrual cup made from medical-grade silicone, with an adjustable pull-tab designed to support removal and up to 12 hours of menstrual protection.

product.name: Flex Daily Liners
product.description: Ultra-thin panty liners for light everyday leak protection, including small leaks and drips. They are fragrance-free, dye-free, hypoallergenic, and dermatologist-tested.

product.name: Foaming Cleanser
product.description: A plant-based, pH-balanced cleanser for washing reusable menstrual cups and discs between uses.

product.name: PMS Eraser
product.description: A daily herbal gummy supplement formulated to support common PMS concerns such as cramps, bloating, mood changes, and fatigue throughout the menstrual cycle.
